limitations: The provider does not expose an immutable backend model snapshot or weights digest for the curator session.

No content-to-content comparison with consumed or development datasets was performed because doing so would violate the no-peek independence boundary; freshness was enforced by isolated source-only curation and an intra-dataset duplicate screen.
The curator performed an independent second review pass equivalent to human span review, but no separate human reviewer participated.
Final worktree cleanliness after the attestation commit is necessarily verified after these bytes are sealed and is reported in the content-free handoff.
